claims.claim_text: The private identifier printed for Paul J. Bourbonniere resolves to a differently named person in the official Army merged file; the conflict is retained and neither identity is promoted.
claims.evidence_excerpt: Identifier resolves to a different name.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The visually checked index identifier produced one official Army record, but its name does not match Paul J. Bourbonniere.
claims.identity_match_assessment: Conflicting. An identifier alone cannot override a wholly different name when the official file itself warns of duplicate and corrupted values.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army record cannot be assigned to the indexed person, so its 1943 entry date and occupation code are withheld.
claims.match_notes: The full identifier and the unrelated Army-record name remain private.
